_maintainer_note: The bundled, OFFLINE starter catalog the build interview searches by goal. It works with the WAN unplugged; nothing here does a live lookup. First-party only in v1: real knowledge packs (downloaded on demand from library.kiwix.org, with size shown before any download), the apps that ship with BuildBot, and the integrations the wizard can wire. Community and store items are NOT offered here yet, because untrusted contributions need the review model that is still being designed. Extend by adding domain-tagged rows; keep tags lowercase keywords a person would actually type. Two tag rules the matcher depends on: (a) never use a filler word as a tag - the goal side strips stopwords such as everything, help, and thing, so such a tag is dead vocabulary that can never match; (b) never tag an item with its own broad domain word, such as tagging the calendar app with home, because that makes every goal about that domain drag the item along with a reason nobody believes. Tag what the item DOES, not where it lives. Every pack in docs/KNOWLEDGE_PACKS.md has a knowledge_pack row here. A pack row says 'available': true only when every id in its 'source_ids' names a download row in config/source_registry.json, and it repeats that row's size_mb, license, license_url, license_checked (true or false), commercial_use and what_it_is so the owner sees them before choosing. Nothing in this repository ships the pack files themselves.
_surfaces_note: Every item also carries a 'surfaces' list: the surfaces a build must LOAD for that item to work. The goal match proposes a surface allowlist from these; surfaces outside the allowlist are not loaded at all, not merely hidden. The taxonomy is deliberately small and is a closed set - add a surface to _surface_taxonomy first, then tag items with it, so the allowlist can never contain a surface nothing knows how to load. Naming is 'family.thing', six families: house (the physical home), media (playback and libraries), knowledge (offline reference corpora), instruments (read-only feeds from measuring gear), comms (scheduling and notification), and daily (the everyday personal apps). Surfaces marked sensitive:true are proposed like any other but the wizard calls them out by name so nobody acquires a camera feed by accident.
